name: Mountain King Style
description:
You are in Mountain King Style.

  • You cannot be moved against your will, and you cannot be knocked Prone unless you choose to be.

  • The Range of your Melee and Ranged Weapons increases by +1.

  • Your maximum Focus is 3. When you enter Mountain King Style, you gain +1 Focus.

  • Build Focus: Once per turn, you may use an Action to gain +1 Focus.

  • Channel the Stone: At the end of your turn, you gain +1 Focus for each of the following:

    • You used the Defend an Area or the Defend an Ally action this turn.

    • You did not move this turn.

  • When you make an Attack Check with a Melee or Ranged weapon you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling to gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

  • If you did not spend or gain any Focus during your turn, Mountain King Style immediately ends. Focus spent between turns is NOT counted for this purpose.

  • If you have 0 Focus at the end of your turn, Mountain King Style immediately ends.

  • If you enter another Stance, Mountain King Style immediately ends.

Mountain King Style: Channel the Stone at the end of your turn. The style ends if you did not spend or gain Focus this turn, or have 0 Focus at the end of your turn.
